statements.t: The company expects increased sales for the second half of the current fiscal year compared with the same period a year ago.
As noted above, the company’s guidance reflects increased sales for the second half of the current fiscal year compared with the same period a year ago.

“Although our second-quarter results reflect delayed customer orders and some industry softness, we remain confident in the underlying aftermarket and in the substantial opportunities we are creating through new customer awards, geographic expansion and improved operating competitiveness,” said Selwyn Joffe, chairman, president and chief executive officer.
Initial shipments have commenced, and we expect the remaining awards to launch during the second half of fiscal 2027, positioning us for additional sales contributions as these awards ramp up.
We are targeting approximately $25 million of additional annualized new business awards by fiscal year end,” Joffe added.
“We believe this will enhance our competitiveness and ability to pursue additional heavy-duty aftermarket business,” Joffe said.
Reflecting delayed customer orders for existing and new business awards, the company is revising its guidance for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
